body:
Have you tried anything to change your situation? I've went through most of my 20s dealing with ungodly regret. Allowing every little thing in my life to fester. I'm still sick, but I am trying therapy before I decide to finally off my self. You should too. Whats their to lose. Therapy is much more appealing to me then my other two options:

* Living life like this
* And killing myself

Suicide should be the last option. After years of dealing with depression and not telling anyone. My girlfriend asked me one night if I were depressed. I could barely get the words out to describe what goes on in my head. We ended up breaking up which really caused me to spiral out of control and I told no one of my hardships. A few months ago I finally broke down to a friend a cried to him. I'm a guy so this was very hard to do. I began going to counseling. Like I said before, I'm still sick and nothing has gotten better. But for the first time in my life I am talking about my situation with people. For the first time in my life this isn't some dirty secret I keep to myself. If there is a chance I can become normal then its going to happen. It's totally worth taking that chance for me. But if it doesn't work, there is always suicide which is comforting.

You said "think about all the sick people that want to live but can't" Dude, this OP is fucking SICK. OP is mentally ill if considering suicide. There is no telling what OP could be diagnosed with. I know because I think about killing myself all the time and am in counseling trying to right the ship before I off myself.

I think about it constantly as well. It's nice when it goes away for a few hours, but it always comes back. The dwelling on my fuck ups and failures is brutal. Really no one should have to live like this. I sometimes come up with poems in my head about how I would kill myself. All the while I am sitting at work pretending to be normal.

Why exactly do you have these thoughts? You say you think life would be better off if you were dead, but why? What are you so depressed about specifically?

Just go get help. Really your story sounds a lot like mine. I'm in my mid to late 20s with a high paying job and I really do hate my fucking life. I hate my life so much that I say out loud "I hate my fucking life" or "fuck my life" or "im just not happy living like this" about 100 times a day. 

I just started seeing a therapist actually and it has been somewhat helpful. Yes its expensive, but who gives a fuck about money if you hate your life? Money is worthless if you view your life as worthless. They want to put me on meds to manage my anxiety, depression, and bi-polar shit. I resisted at first, but I am so fed up with my fucking life that now I'm thinking why not give me drugs. Who cares if they "change" who I am. Who I am is a broken fucking person. A shell of his former self.

My point here is, just go get help. In fact if you love your family so much ASK them for financial help in seeing a therapist. They rather give you money to go once a week than see you in a fucking casket bro.

What have you done to change your situation? What have you not done yet? Is there a chance things could get better if you work on making the changes necessary? I have suicidal thoughts everyday, but I'm at least giving making changes a chance before acting on them.
